purpose: Falsify whether KNOW20's fixed two-slot memory earns a genuine return-regime advantage over matched rolling, reset and Bayesian controls when a causal rule switches at unseen timings.
research_role: Independent contributor on existing Yggdrasil PR #1327, NOT Amalgam PR #1278 canonical learner owner

source.data: separately generated source-free synthetic binary consequence stream; never original-world material
source.private_law: Initial hidden best action r∈{0,1}, flips at frozen world-specific times; optimal action = r XOR (number of switches so far modulo2). Agent sees only public numeric scene ID, action, and one witnessed stochastic reward
source.no_private_leakage: Neither active regime, shift times, true role nor exogenous reward coin supplied to non-oracle control
source.reward: Bernoulli 0.8 if chosen action optimal, 0.2 otherwise; SHA256('know21:private:noise:v1:'+seed+':'+role+':'+step) common random number for each policy; noise never supplied as input
source.public_scene_alias: KNOW20 six HELD public scene identifiers are reused as permitted state keys, one per scenario family. NEW held causal schedules and private noise seeds; NOT source-identity novelty or unfamiliar causal grammar.

budgets.policy_reinit: Fresh fixed-size model per held world, no previous held future, no teacher labels, no lookahead
budgets.old_task_check: Within each world score initial, intervening, and returned segments on SAME persistent state, not a separately-keyed scene proxy

candidate: Re-run KNOW20 NativeSparseRegimeMemory byte-identical from frozen parent, without editing parameters/thresholds or retrying hidden worlds.
matched_controls: KNOW20 BayesianHMM known family p0.8/0.2 hazard1/16 without shift times

metrics.primary: Expected regret/action =0.6 * fraction choosing suboptimal arm, aggregate all 1152 actions; lower better
secondary: Return-only expected regret on final segment of even-flip schedules (20 worlds, both roles; excludes odd-flip family)
Realized reward and prequential Brier under shared exogenous noise
Switch count and forced-slot changes on same scene
Single-witness per step and deterministic repeated proof/receipt
Whole-script wall time and total model bytes, no claimed external cost

hypotheses.survival: Native return-only expected regret at least 0.02 lower than the same-detector ResetBeta AND at least 0.01 lower than RollingBeta; otherwise NO_GO_RETURN_MEMORY.
hypotheses.overall: Native overall regret at least 0.03 below StationaryBeta; report independently and do not combine into success after seeing outcome.
hypotheses.strongest_control: Strong conventional Bayesian / rolling controls may win; never claim science gain unless fully matched strongest control is beaten in independent qualifying real source with withheld causal rules.

gates.engineering: Source type controls and 1152 actions per policy, cold checkpoint and replay integrity inherited unchanged, exact source qualified in Linux/Windows CI; measured results recorded even if negative.
gates.development: Only if survival and overall hypotheses both satisfy fixed numeric thresholds, label RETURN_MEMORY_DEVELOPMENT_SUPPORTED; otherwise RETURN_MEMORY_NO_GO or MIXED according to frozen two predicates; no retuning.
gates.scientific: SCIENTIFIC_UNVERIFIED_OR_NO_GO regardless of synthetic development improvement; canonical Yggdrasil unaffected.

stops: One frozen protocol and cohort, no threshold/seed/shift/cost edits after primary run; preserve all negative evidence. Source-typed research-only; no merge, canonical train, controller, automatic execution outside existing contributor CI, paid APIs, protected first use or deployment.
